input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The root cause is in `handleClick` in ExportButton.tsx: it calls `exportReport(...).then(...)` but never attaches a `.catch` (or try/catch) handler. When the fetch resolves with a non-2xx status, `exportReport` throws, the promise rejects, and `setBusy(false)` is never reached, so the button stays disabled until a full page reload. The fix is to also reset `busy` to false (and ideally show an error toast) in a catch/finally branch around the `exportReport` call.

input.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
input.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. The handleClick function's call to exportReport only resets busy state and shows a toast in the success path (.then), with no .catch or error handling. When the export promise rejects (e.g. server error), busy stays true forever, leaving the button greyed out until a page reload. Fix by adding a .catch (or try/catch with async/await) that resets setBusy(false) and shows an error toast on failure, ensuring the button becomes clickable again after a failed export.
